# Logistic Regression 

```{r}
balanced_dt <- load("~/Documents/GitHub/Fairness/fairness-cpm/balanced.RData")

logreg <- glm(Event ~ Group + Predictor, family = binomial, data = balanced_dt)

summary(logreg)
```

## Visualization of the group distributions

```{r}
pred_logreg <- predict(logreg, type = "response")

group0 <- pred_logreg[balanced_dt$Group == 0]
group1 <- pred_logreg[balanced_dt$Group == 1]

pred_logreg <- as.data.frame(cbind(group0, group1))
```

# Random forest 

```{r}
rf <- randomForest(Event ~ Group + Predictor,  data = balanced_dt)

pred_rf <- predict(rf)

group0 <- pred_rf[balanced_dt$Group == 0]
group1 <- pred_rf[balanced_dt$Group == 1]

pred_rf <- as.data.frame(cbind(group0, group1))
```

## Visualize 

```{r}
# long data format for predictions

pred_logreg_long <- pred_logreg |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),       
               names_to = "name",
               values_to = "prediction")

pred_rf_long <- pred_rf |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),       
               names_to = "name",
               values_to = "prediction")

plot_logreg <- pred_logreg_long |> 
  mutate(myaxis = paste0(name)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = myaxis, y = prediction, fill = name, alpha = 0.3)) +
    geom_violin(width = 1.4) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "azure1", alpha = 0.2) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = Inf,
      label = paste0(
        "Event fraction Group 0: 0.5",
        "\nEvent fraction Group 1: 0.5",
        "\nSize of Group 0: 25",
        "\nSize of Group 1: 25"
      ),
      vjust = 1.2,
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15)
    ) +
    ggtitle("Predictions of Group 0 vs. Group 1 using log reg") +
    xlab("")

```
